We keep the practice small on purpose: you talk to the lawyer handling your matter, not an assistant, and we return calls within a day.

faqs.question: What does a first consultation cost?
faqs.answer: Estate planning consultations are free. Family law consultations are $250 for an hour, credited to your fees if you hire us.

faqs.question: Do I need a trust, or just a will?
faqs.answer: In California a trust usually keeps your family out of probate court. We will tell you plainly if a will is enough.

faqs.question: Can we meet by video?
faqs.answer: Yes. Documents can be signed in our office, or with a mobile notary at your home.

posts.title: When should you update your trust?
posts.excerpt: Five life events that mean it is time to look at your estate plan again.
posts.body_md:
A trust is only as good as its **last update**.

## Time to review it when

- A child is born or marries
- You buy or sell a home
- You move to *another state*

[Book a review call](https://book.example/hale-morrow) and we will tell you if anything needs to change.
